correctness.rationale: For every integer dimension at least three, the unsigned cube incidence matrix gives the line-graph Laplacian resolvent identity. An exact product heat-kernel integral constructs the dipole potential, strictly orders its Hamming-weight levels, and yields four binomial electrical-current sums. Source-edge corrections and the exact integral at level one prove the stated cut norm; symmetry and projector trace prove the cycle norm. The proof handles boundaries, units and quantifiers; 124 independent exact grounded-Laplacian columns and exact integrals for dimensions 3 through 40 corroborate the identities, without extrapolating finite computations.

value.rationale: The line graph is a classical natural transformation of the Hamming cube, studied for electrical resistance invariants. An exact all-dimensional cut and cycle projection-norm classification is intrinsic Banach-space information not implied by its known Kirchhoff index. The leading growth coefficient drops from one half for the original cube to one quarter for its line graph, quantifying an operator-norm response to a natural structural change; the finite corrections and complement formula are explicit and reproducible.
